page.layout: One printed page: one column of running text, with an empty margin on the left and no marginal notes. The right edge shows part of the facing page, which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: pellicere tentauit Maximianus. Hunc autem in modum, reliquorum nomine respondent Mauricius Tribunus Legionis, Exsuperius Vexillarius & Candidus ordinis Senatorij vir; paratos scilicet se esse Imperatori in omnibus esse subie-ctos, atque aduersus barbaros (quod aliis sæpe fecerant) strenuè pugnaturos: Verùm quòd Christianam Religionem colerent, se neutiquàm fore immolaturos, Responsum hercle prudens, animosum, modestū, Christianis dignum. Veruntamē exinde magis excādescens Maximianus, eos bis decimandos & subinde residuos omnes in fide persistentes trucidandos mandat. Si huic Legioni aliquis tū pręfuisset[?] Marianista, quàm acriter militum animos ad sua tela in Imperatoris caput & iugulum vibranda, tanquam monstri alicuius aut immanis bestiæ inflammasset, vel saltem ad suas copias cum Amando & Æliano (ad quos perduelles supprimendos hanc expeditionem suscepit Maximianus) iungendas sollicitasset: sed illi aliter à suis edoēti[?] Episcopis, maluerunt mille perpeti mortes, quàm sui Impe-ratoris

page.notes: Running head is "Scutum Regium"; the division marker "Lib. II." at the top right is not included. The left margin is empty. Doubtful readings are marked [?]: "pręfuisset" (the mark over the e is unclear), "edoēti" (the mark over the e is unclear). "subie-ctos" uses a ct ligature, transcribed as "ct". Italic runs follow the scan: the names Mauricius Tribunus, Exsuperius, Candidus, Maximianus, Marianista, Amando and Æliano, and the opening word Maximianus.
